posts.text:
DAMN WTF, i was not expecting them to cook this hard for Noelle vs Vanica

3-4 minutes of straight up fighting (the animation quality for Noelle vs Vanica jumped up significantly after Vanicas flashback with Acier, 3-4 mins = after Acier fb, there is some action before that fb obvs)

peak action boards + animation in some cuts is really fucking good, both Noelle and Vanica had very strong AD work (especially Noelle) + Noelle's Valkyrie Dress transformation is good as well

the overall OST usage in this ep is really good too, im just not a fan of the cinemascope usage in the flashbacks 

overall, 8.5/10
